name: ag-carry-quintile-exhibit
description: Professional factor study: does carry (M1-M2)/M1 predict next-quarter roll yield in corn and soybeans? Rank-based quintile sort on expanding carry distribution (2010-2025). Four exhibits: Q5-Q1 factor spread (tradability), cumulative returns by quintile (persistence), boxplot by quintile (distribution), cross-asset factor statistics (verification).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AG CARRY QUINTILE FACTOR STUDY — PROFESSIONAL EXHIBIT DESIGN
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does carry predict forward roll yield in ag futures?
# Method:   Expanding quantile breakpoints via cumulative(agg=Quantile)
#           True rank-based percentiles, no normality assumption, no warmup waste
# Assets:   ZC (corn), ZS (soybeans) — runs per-asset, cs_ reporters combine
# Forward:  63 trading days (~1 quarter)
# Exhibits: 1) Q5-Q1 spread  2) Cumulative by quintile
#           3) Boxplot        4) Factor statistics table
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS FUTURES — carry from built-in output, adjusted close for returns
# =============================================================================

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry
close = cont.c

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD 63-DAY RETURN
# =============================================================================

fwd_63d_raw = ((close << 63) - close) / close
fwd_63d = where(close > 0, fwd_63d_raw)

# =============================================================================
# QUINTILE ASSIGNMENT — EXPANDING QUANTILE BREAKPOINTS
# cumulative(agg=Quantile) computes expanding percentiles from inception
# True rank-based breakpoints, no normality assumption, no warmup waste
# =============================================================================

p20 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.2)(carry)
p40 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.4)(carry)
p60 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.6)(carry)
p80 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.8)(carry)

is_q1 = is_valid(carry) and (carry <= p20)
is_q2 = is_valid(carry) and (carry > p20) and (carry <= p40)
is_q3 = is_valid(carry) and (carry > p40) and (carry <= p60)
is_q4 = is_valid(carry) and (carry > p60) and (carry <= p80)
is_q5 = is_valid(carry) and (carry > p80)

# =============================================================================
# PER-QUINTILE FILTERED SERIES
# =============================================================================

# Forward returns by quintile (for boxplot + stats)
fwd_q1 = where(is_q1, fwd_63d)
fwd_q2 = where(is_q2, fwd_63d)
fwd_q3 = where(is_q3, fwd_63d)
fwd_q4 = where(is_q4, fwd_63d)
fwd_q5 = where(is_q5, fwd_63d)

# Carry values by quintile (for stats table)
carry_q1 = where(is_q1, carry)
carry_q2 = where(is_q2, carry)
carry_q3 = where(is_q3, carry)
carry_q4 = where(is_q4, carry)
carry_q5 = where(is_q5, carry)

# Hit rates (positive forward return)
hit_q1 = where(is_q1, 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q2 = where(is_q2, 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q3 = where(is_q3, 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q4 = where(is_q4, 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q5 = where(is_q5, 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# Observation counts
count_q1 = where(is_q1, 1.0)
count_q2 = where(is_q2, 1.0)
count_q3 = where(is_q3, 1.0)
count_q4 = where(is_q4, 1.0)
count_q5 = where(is_q5, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# EXHIBIT 1 — Q5-Q1 FACTOR SPREAD (THE TRADABILITY CHART)
# Cumulative tracking: +fwd when Q5, -fwd when Q1, 0 otherwise
# If carry predicts returns, this line drifts upward over time
# =============================================================================

q5_daily = fwd_63d if is_q5 else 0.0
q5_clean = q5_daily if is_valid(q5_daily) else 0.0
q1_daily = fwd_63d if is_q1 else 0.0
q1_clean = q1_daily if is_valid(q1_daily) else 0.0
spread_daily = q5_clean - q1_clean
cum_spread = cumulative()(spread_daily)

# =============================================================================
# EXHIBIT 2 — CUMULATIVE RETURNS BY QUINTILE (THE PERSISTENCE CHART)
# 5 lines showing cumulative forward return contribution per quintile
# Monotonic separation = real signal; episodic spikes = noise
# =============================================================================

cum_q1_daily = (fwd_63d if is_q1 else 0.0) if is_valid(fwd_63d if is_q1 else 0.0) else 0.0
cum_q2_daily = (fwd_63d if is_q2 else 0.0) if is_valid(fwd_63d if is_q2 else 0.0) else 0.0
cum_q3_daily = (fwd_63d if is_q3 else 0.0) if is_valid(fwd_63d if is_q3 else 0.0) else 0.0
cum_q4_daily = (fwd_63d if is_q4 else 0.0) if is_valid(fwd_63d if is_q4 else 0.0) else 0.0
cum_q5_daily = (fwd_63d if is_q5 else 0.0) if is_valid(fwd_63d if is_q5 else 0.0) else 0.0

cum_q1 = cumulative()(cum_q1_daily)
cum_q2 = cumulative()(cum_q2_daily)
cum_q3 = cumulative()(cum_q3_daily)
cum_q4 = cumulative()(cum_q4_daily)
cum_q5 = cumulative()(cum_q5_daily)

# =============================================================================
# BOXPLOT GROUPED MODE — quintile label + single value column
# =============================================================================

q_num = (1.0 if is_q1 else 0.0) + (2.0 if is_q2 else 0.0) + (3.0 if is_q3 else 0.0) + (4.0 if is_q4 else 0.0) + (5.0 if is_q5 else 0.0)
q_valid = where(q_num > 0, q_num)
q_label = stringify()(q_valid)
fwd_boxplot = where(q_num > 0, fwd_63d)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Exhibit 1: Q5-Q1 Factor Spread (cross-asset, one chart) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Carry Factor Spread: Long Q5 (Backwardation) / Short Q1 (Contango)',
    category='Carry Factor Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Q5-Q1 Spread',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=0
)(bar_idx, cum_spread)

# --- Exhibit 2: Cumulative Returns by Quintile (per-asset, 5 series) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative 63d Forward Returns by Carry Quintile',
    category='Carry Factor Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Contango)', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Sky),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_idx, cum_q1, cum_q2, cum_q3, cum_q4, cum_q5)

# --- Exhibit 3: Distribution by Quintile (per-asset, boxplot grouped mode) ---
boxplot(
    title='63d Forward Return Distribution by Carry Quintile',
    category='Carry Factor Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Quintile (1=Contango, 5=Backwardation)',
    y_axis_label='63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_outliers=True,
    whisker_iqr=1.5,
    colors=[Color.Red, Color.Orange, Color.Gray, Color.Sky, Color.Blue],
    order=2
)(q_label, fwd_boxplot)

# --- Exhibit 4: Factor Statistics Table (per-asset, 5 quintile rows) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Factor Statistics by Quintile',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Q1 (Deepest Contango)', 'Q2', 'Q3 (Neutral)', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)'],
        col_headers=['Trading Days', 'Avg Carry', 'Median 63d Fwd', 'Hit Rate (>0)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Sky),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Factor Analysis',
    order=3
)(count_q1, carry_q1, fwd_q1, hit_q1, count_q2, carry_q2, fwd_q2, hit_q2, count_q3, carry_q3, fwd_q3, hit_q3, count_q4, carry_q4, fwd_q4, hit_q4, count_q5, carry_q5, fwd_q5, hit_q5)

# --- Event Markers: Quintile transitions ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Quintile Assignment',
        icon=Icon.LayersIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Q5 Threshold (p80)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='63d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DTE', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    )
)(is_q5, where(is_q5, carry), where(is_q5, p80), where(is_q5, fwd_63d), where(is_q5, cont.dte))
